WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-104.848585 39.697902, -104.847904 39.698274, -104.847504 39.698271, -104.847502 39.69875, -104.847499 39.699152, -104.847511 39.699195, -104.847534 39.699229, -104.847551 39.699263, -104.847553 39.699377)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-73.759821 42.650186, -73.759158 42.649826, -73.759094 42.649889, -73.758672 42.649669)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'East Hoye Drive' ELSE 'Empire State Plaza Concourse' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-104.848585 39.697902, -104.847904 39.698274, -104.847504 39.698271, -104.847502 39.69875, -104.847499 39.699152, -104.847511 39.699195, -104.847534 39.699229, -104.847551 39.699263, -104.847553 39.699377)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
empire_state_plaza_concourse AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-73.759821 42.650186, -73.759158 42.649826, -73.759094 42.649889, -73.758672 42.649669)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
east_hoye_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast, 
        true, 
        (SELECT geom FROM east_hoye_drive)
      ), 
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast, 
    (SELECT geom FROM east_hoye_drive)
  )
),
empire_state_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast, 
        true, 
        (SELECT geom FROM empire_state_plaza_concourse)
      ), 
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast, 
    (SELECT geom FROM empire_state_plaza_concourse)
    )
)
SELECT 
  'East Hoye Drive' AS name,
  ST_Stats((SELECT slope_rast FROM east_hoye_slope), 1).mean AS mean_slope
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Empire State Plaza Concourse' AS name,
  ST_Stats((SELECT slope_rast FROM empire_state_slope), 1).mean AS mean_slope
ORDER BY mean_slope DESC
LIMIT 1;
